cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

mechanism: Copy a speech editor's bolding as emphasis, gain credit for the resulting line, then use its established importance to enlarge the authorship claim.
confusable: Not just asking for broad credit: B2 must expose the copied mark's different meaning and the small concession must support the wider argument.
comparison: Written rhetoric and attribution rather than crowded windowsill use.
seedUse: Retains opening paragraph as foundation for wider speech credit; adds copied bold text originally marking deletions.
